We employ six statistical metrics to assess the agreement between human annotated scores and model generated scores. We use the following four common statistical metrics: the mean absolute error (e), Pearson (r), Spearman (ρ), and Kendall correlation coefficient (τ). We also propose a novel metric, "alignment score", to evaluate the alignment capabilities of VLMs.
